Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
This is a reminder to all players of the Southeast Regional Qualifier
Tournament this coming Saturday the 25th of May 2002.

Registration will begin at 10:30 and start at 11:00. The tourney is a
three
round + final event that will be held at the War Room in Norcross,
Georgia.

Directions to the War Room:
From Atlanta:
1.) Go 85 North until exit 101 which is Indian Trail Road.
2.) Take a left and cross back over the highway.
3.) Go through the first traffic light and you will pass an Arby's.
4.) Take a short left into the strip shopping center right past
Arby's. The
shopping center has a Save-Rite Supermarket in it and the War Room is
next door.

The War Rooms phone number is (770) 729-9588. The address is 2055
Beaver
Ruin Road.

There is no entry charge for the tourney and prizes will be supplied
by
White Wolf.

Top 10 players from this event will qualify to play at the Continental
Championship at GenCon in Milwaukee, Wisconsin on August 10th, 2002.

For more info, email Todd Bannister - vtesr...@white-wolf.com or
Jeff Thompson - TheLa...@hotmail.com.

Hope to bleed you there.

Carpe noctem.

Lasombra

http://www.TheLasombra.com/tournaments.htm
